name: Consult Master Gadrin

narrative.details:
The venom from the broodguards wasn't as potent as the venom you brought originally.  It must have come from a different spider.

I want a fresh sample of that venom.  To find out where it came from, you must consult with a troll who knows the Witherbark well--Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.  Travel to Durotar and speak with Gadrin.  With luck, he'll know where the Witherbarks get their venom.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, so you want fresh venom from the spider of the witherbarks, yes? Well, sit down... you're not going to like what I have to tell you.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 43 to 55, 32,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Venom Bottles
quests.objectiveText: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
quests.objectiveText: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Consult Master Gadrin
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

quests.name: The Spider God
quests.objectiveText: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

quests.name: Summoning Shadra
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Venom to the Undercity
quests.objectiveText: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
